nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: Minimal ESLint flat config for the NestJS API app that simply re-exports the root workspace configuration.

nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: ESLint flat config for the CLI app extending the root config and banning console.log in TypeScript files in favor of consoleLogger utilities.

nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: ESLint flat config for the React frontend: extends root and Nx React presets, and forbids factory-less vi.mock/vi.doMock calls in specs because the Vitest suite runs with isolate:false.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an ESLint AST selector in no-restricted-syntax to enforce a testing convention specific to Vitest isolate:false mode.

nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: ESLint config for the local eslint-rules project, extending the root config and allowing require() since rules are authored as CommonJS.

nodes.name: index.js
nodes.summary: Local ESLint plugin entry point that registers the Packmind workspace rules (use-case-filename, usecase-casing, throw-kind-carrying-error) for consumption by the root config.

nodes.name: throw-kind-carrying-error.js
nodes.summary: Type-aware ESLint rule requiring every thrown value in domain/application layers to carry a known `kind` and string `reason` recognized by DomainExceptionFilter, so the API does not answer 500.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the TypeScript compiler API via typescript-eslint parserServices to inspect union, intersection, and base types of thrown expressions.

nodes.name: use-case-filename.js
nodes.summary: ESLint rule enforcing structural use-case naming under application/useCases: flags the legacy dotted .usecase filename suffix and exported classes missing the UseCase suffix.

nodes.name: usecase-casing.js
nodes.summary: Repo-wide ESLint rule flagging the mis-cased "Usecase" in filenames and identifiers and suggesting the "UseCase" spelling.

nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: Root ESLint flat config for the Nx monorepo: combines Nx/typescript-eslint presets, registers the local packmind plugin with use-case naming and type-aware throw rules scoped to domain/application layers, and enforces Nx module boundary constraints for source and test files.
nodes.languageNotes: Computes rule file globs dynamically from process.cwd() so the same config works whether ESLint runs from the repo root or a project directory.

nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: ESLint flat config for the accounts package: extends the root workspace config and enables @nx/dependency-checks on JSON files (parsed with jsonc-eslint-parser), ignoring the eslint config file itself.

nodes.name: extendsError
nodes.summary: Recursively walks intersection and base types via the TypeScript checker to determine whether a type ultimately extends Error.

nodes.name: carriesKnownKind
nodes.summary: Checks that a type has a required literal `kind` from the domain or error-only families and a string `reason`, and that error-only kinds extend Error.
